# R3 npm audit waiver list (PRD Q4) — consumed by the production gate in
# .github/workflows/build-windows.yml.
#
# One advisory ID (GHSA-… or CVE-…) per line. A production high/critical
# finding is waived only when EVERY advisory in its via-chain is listed here.
# Each entry needs a comment line directly above it: reason + review-by date
# (review-by <= 90 days out; expired waivers must be re-triaged or removed).
#
# Example:
#   # reason: dev-chain only impact, no patched release yet
#   # review-by: 2027-01-16
#   GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx
#
# Empty today — production dependencies have zero high/critical findings.
